meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档转成可爱的幻灯片 PDF，并尝试生成一个手机端分享链接。整个过程由 Claude 自动调用 NotebookLM 完成。
howto.when: 当用户要求‘wowerpoint’某个文件、把报告变成幻灯片，或提出‘做个关于某主题的演示文稿’等请求时触发。

say.note: 会生成可爱的 PDF 和分享链接

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii slide-deck PDF and attempts to generate a mobile share link via the WOWerpoint Server. Claude uses NotebookLM to create the deck.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to 'wowerpoint' a file, turn a report into slides, or make a deck about a subject.

say_en.note: Generates a kawaii PDF and share link

say_en.text: Make a deck about the company intro
